issue.title: `:` Task Link Picker for bob capture and Bob Mac Capture
issue.description: Typing `:` at the start of any capture item, including any item of a blank-line-separated batch draft, opens a fast, beautiful fuzzy picker over every open (not done or canceled) task in the vault's area and project notes. Accepting a task replaces the `:` query with the canonical `@route:block-id` link. Tasks without a block ID get one first, from a prefilled suggestion. The link can then be captured as-is or started with `=`, so any task can be linked into today's Pomodoros in a few keystrokes.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202609/task_link_picker.md requests this work

issue.title: Vault-wide linkable-task discovery and fuzzy ranking
issue.description: discovery: add the read-only `capture_link_tasks` scanner. It collects Ready, Blocked, Next, and In Progress tasks from area, project, and inbox notes. It adds groups, the canonical order, ledger annotation, block-ID suggestions, schedule pull-forward flags, and a deterministic tiered fuzzy ranker, all with unit tests.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/task_link_picker.md defines phase discovery as one work unit

issue.title: `:` picker-query grammar in capture, capture-parse, and completion fields
issue.description: grammar: add one claim predicate for single-token `:` items. Execution rejects them with teaching errors T1 and T2. capture-parse reports `incomplete` with `needs: ["task_link"]`. The completion field (`task_link` context) covers the sigil. Also update help text and add a claim-equivalence test.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/task_link_picker.md defines phase grammar as one work unit

issue.title: CaptureCore task-link picker index, source, and decoding
issue.description: mac_core: in bob-mac-capture's CaptureCore, decode the new candidate fields and add the `taskLink` picker source and need. Add `TaskLinkPickerIndex` with grouped and fuzzy-filtered presentations, rows keyed by route and ref, and a `:`-aware FuzzyQuery. Cover it with unit tests and verify on macOS CI.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/task_link_picker.md defines phase mac_core as one work unit

issue.title: `task_link` completion candidates, round-trip tests, and docs
issue.description: complete: wire discovery into the `task_link` context of `bob capture-complete`, with a pinned JSON schema, human rows, and help. Prove accept-then-capture round trips (including capture-task-id for tasks without an ID), check real-vault latency, and document the feature in docs/capture.md and README.md.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/task_link_picker.md defines phase complete as one work unit

issue.title: Bob Mac Capture task-link picker panel, ID prompt, and keys
issue.description: mac_panel: route the `task_link` context into the picker card. Accept inserts `@route:id`, Shift-Return inserts it with `=`, and Command-Return inserts it and captures. Tasks without an ID open a prefilled Add block ID prompt that assigns the ID and splices the link, and Escape returns to the picker. Also update the views, README, real-bob fixtures, and tests, and get macOS CI green.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202609/task_link_picker.md defines phase mac_panel as one work unit
